en
                index = i
                break
            end
        end
        if not index then return end

        local length = #TabIconCarousel.Items * TAB_ICON_STEP
        local target = (index - 1) * TAB_ICON_STEP + TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2 - TabIconCarousel.ViewW / 2
        local delta = (target - TabIconCarousel.Offset + length / 2) % length - length / 2
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0

        if animate then
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = {
                From = TabIconCarousel.Offset,
                To = TabIconCarousel.Offset + delta,
                T0 = os.clock(),
                Dur = 0.35,
            }
        else
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset + delta
            renderTabCarousel()
            TabIconCarousel.Spin = 0
            applyTabCarouselSpin()
        end
    end

    local function relayoutTabCarousel()
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then return end
        TabIconCarousel.ViewW = TabCarouselViewport.AbsoluteSize.X / tabCarouselScale()
        TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
        renderTabCarousel()
        if TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab then
            focusTabCarousel(TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab, false)
        end
    end

    local carouselPress = nil

    local function onTabCarouselPress(input, item)
        local inputType = input.UserInputType
        if inputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if carouselPress then return end

        TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
        TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
        carouselPress = {
            Input = input,
            StartX = input.Position.X,
            LastX = input.Position.X,
            LastT = os.clock(),
            Moved = false,
            Item = item,
        }
    end

    function Window._RegisterCarouselTab(tab, button, onSelect)
        for _, existing in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
            if existing.Tab == tab then return end
        end

        local item = {
            Tab = tab,
            Button = button,
            Select = onSelect,
            Scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, button),
        }
        table.insert(TabIconCarousel.Items, item)

        button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if TabIconCarousel.Enabled then
                onTabCarouselPress(input, item)
            end
        end)
    end

    function Window._RefreshTabIconLayout()
        local useCarousel = (SavedConfig.TabIconLayout or "Original") == "Carousel"
        TabIconCarousel.Enabled = useCarousel

        if useCarousel then
            if Window.CompactNavigation and Window.SetCompactNavigation then
                Window:SetCompactNavigation(false)
            end
            local navOpenBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationOpen")
            local navCloseBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationClose")
            if navOpenBtn then navOpenBtn.Visible = false end
            if navCloseBtn then navCloseBtn.Visible = false end
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -48)
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            TabList.Visible = false
            TabListArt.Visible = false
            TabListDivider.Visible = false
            TabListDividerGlow.Visible = false
            CatImage.Visible = false
            TabCarousel.Visible = true

            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
                if tab.Button and tab.Button.Parent ~= TabCarouselViewport then
                    tab.Button.Parent = TabCarouselViewport
                end
                if tab.Button then
                    tab.Button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TAB_ICON_SIZE, TAB_ICON_SIZE)
                    tab.Button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    tab.Button.Rotation = 0
                    tab.Button.Text = ""
                    tab.Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                    tab.Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, TAB_ICON_SIZE / 2, 0.5, 0)
                    tab.Button.ZIndex = 18
                    tab.Button.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
                end
                if tab.IconLabel then
                    local iconSize = math.clamp((tonumber((Theme.IconSizes or {}).Tab) or 24) + 3, 12, 35)
                    tab.IconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize)
                    tab.IconLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(iconSize / 2), 0.5, -(iconSize / 2))
                    tab.IconLabel.ZIndex = 19
                    tab.IconLabel.Visible = true
                end
                if tab.NameLabel then
                    tab.NameLabel.Visible = false
                end
                if tab.SpotifyMark then
                    tab.SpotifyMark.Visible = false
                end
            end

            TabIconCarousel.ViewW = TabCarouselViewport.AbsoluteSize.X / tabCarouselScale()
            renderTabCarousel()
            if TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab then
                focusTabCarousel(TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab, false)
            end
        else
            local navOpenBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationOpen")
            local navCloseBtn = Body:FindFirstChild("CompactNavigationClose")
            if navOpenBtn then navOpenBtn.Visible = not Window.CompactNavigation end
            if navCloseBtn then navCloseBtn.Visible = Window.CompactNavigation == true end
            ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -118, 1, 0)
            ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 118, 0, 0)
            TabCarousel.Visible = false
            TabList.Visible = true
            TabListArt.Visible = true
            TabListDivider.Visible = false -- v15: sin línea divisoria
            TabListDividerGlow.Visible = false

            for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
                if tab.Button then
                    tab.Button.Parent = TabList
                    tab.Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
                    tab.Button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                    tab.Button.Rotation = -3
                    tab.Button.Text = ""
                    tab.Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    tab.Button.ZIndex = 8
                    tab.Button.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
                end
                if tab.IconLabel then
                    local iconSize = math.clamp(tonumber((Theme.IconSizes or {}).Tab) or 24, 12, 32)
                    tab.IconLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize, iconSize)
                    tab.IconLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -(iconSize / 2))
                    tab.IconLabel.ZIndex = 9
                    tab.IconLabel.Rotation = 0
                    tab.IconLabel.Visible = true
                end
                if tab.NameLabel then
                    tab.NameLabel.Visible = true
                end
                if tab.SpotifyMark then
                    tab.SpotifyMark.Visible = (tab.NameSpanish == "Spotify")
                end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(TabIconCarousel.Items) do
                if item.Scale then item.Scale.Scale = 1 end
            end
            resetScrollTop(TabList)
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = 0
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
            TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil
            TabIconCarousel.Spin = 0
            applyTabCarouselSpin()
        end
    end

    function Window:SetTabIconLayout(layout)
        local mode = layout == "Carousel" and "Carousel" or "Original"
        SavedConfig.TabIconLayout = mode
        self.TabIconLayout = mode
        SaveConfig()
        self._RefreshTabIconLayout()
    end

    TabCarouselViewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(relayoutTabCarousel)

    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled or not carouselPress then return end

        local pressType = carouselPress.Input.UserInputType
        local inputType = input.UserInputType
        local matches = (inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and pressType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
            or (inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and pressType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
        if not matches then return end

        local x = input.Position.X
        local dxScreen = x - carouselPress.LastX
        if not carouselPress.Moved and math.abs(x - carouselPress.StartX) > TAB_DRAG_THRESHOLD * tabCarouselScale() then
            carouselPress.Moved = true
        end

        if carouselPress.Moved then
            local now = os.clock()
            local dt = math.max(now - carouselPress.LastT, 1 / 240)
            local dx = dxScreen / tabCarouselScale()
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset - dx
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = TabIconCarousel.Velocity * 0.5 + (-dx / dt) * 0.5
            carouselPress.LastT = now
            renderTabCarousel()
        end
        carouselPress.LastX = x
    end))

    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled or not carouselPress then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= carouselPress.Input.UserInputType then return end

        local finished = carouselPress
        carouselPress = nil

        if finished.Moved then
            if os.clock() - finished.LastT > 0.08 then
                TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
            end
        elseif finished.Item and finished.Item.Select then
            finished.Item.Select()
        end
    end))

    track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then return end

        if TabIconCarousel.Spin ~= 0 then
            TabIconCarousel.Spin = TabIconCarousel.Spin * math.exp(-TAB_SPIN_DECAY * dt)
            if math.abs(TabIconCarousel.Spin) < 0.05 then TabIconCarousel.Spin = 0 end
            applyTabCarouselSpin()
        end

        if carouselPress and carouselPress.Moved then return end

        local anim = TabIconCarousel.Anim
        if anim then
            local t = math.min((os.clock() - anim.T0) / anim.Dur, 1)
            local eased = 1 - (1 - t) ^ 3
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = anim.From + (anim.To - anim.From) * eased
            if t >= 1 then TabIconCarousel.Anim = nil end
            renderTabCarousel()
        elseif math.abs(TabIconCarousel.Velocity) > 8 then
            TabIconCarousel.Offset = TabIconCarousel.Offset + TabIconCarousel.Velocity * dt
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = TabIconCarousel.Velocity * math.exp(-TAB_FRICTION * dt)
            renderTabCarousel()
        elseif TabIconCarousel.Velocity ~= 0 then
            TabIconCarousel.Velocity = 0
        end
    end))

    function Window:CreateTab(nameSpanish, nameEnglishOrIcon, iconAsset)
        local nameEnglish = nameSpanish
        if nameEnglishOrIcon and string.find(nameEnglishOrIcon, "rbxassetid") then
            iconAsset = nameEnglishOrIcon
            nameEnglish = nameSpanish
        elseif nameEnglishOrIcon then
            nameEnglish = nameEnglishOrIcon
        end
        
        local displayName = GetText(nameSpanish, nameEnglish)

        local defaultIconAsset = iconAsset
        local themedTabIcons = ThemeTabIcons[Theme.ThemeName]
        if themedTabIcons then
            iconAsset = themedTabIcons[nameEnglish] or themedTabIcons[nameSpanish] or iconAsset
        end
        
        local TabButton = mk("TextButton", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            Text = "",
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 15,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            ClipsDescendants = false,
            Rotation = -3,
            ZIndex = 8
        }, TabList)
        TabButton:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        TabButton.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
        corner(TabButton, 6)

        local textStart = 38
        local TabIconLabel = nil
        local SpotifyMark = nil
        if iconAsset then
            local iconSize = math.clamp(tonumber((Theme.IconSizes or {}).Tab) or 24, 12, 32)
            local iconPos = 7
            TabIconLabel = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = TabButton,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, iconSize, 0, iconSize),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, iconPos, 0.5, -(iconSize / 2)),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = iconAsset,
                ImageColor3 = Theme.TabIcon or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            YinIcons.applyTab(TabIconLabel, nameEnglish, nameSpanish)
            textStart = 14 + iconSize
        end

        if nameSpanish == "Spotify" then
            SpotifyMark = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = TabButton,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 10),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, textStart, 0, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = "rbxassetid://74630849553567",
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
        end

        local TabNameLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
            Parent = TabButton,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -(textStart + 10), 1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, textStart, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = displayName,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 15,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None,
            ClipsDescendants = false,
            ZIndex = 9
        })
        TabNameLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", nameSpanish)
        TabNameLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", nameEnglish)

        resetScrollTop(TabList)

        local TabPage = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ScrollBarThickness = 2,
            ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
            CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            Visible = false,
            ZIndex = 8,
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        }, ContentArea)
        mk("UIListLayout", {
            Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
        }, TabPage)

        local function clampTabScroll()
            task.defer(function()
                if not TabPage.Parent then return end
                local maxY = math.max(0, TabPage.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - TabPage.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
                if TabPage.CanvasPosition.Y > maxY then
                    TabPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(TabPage.CanvasPosition.X, maxY)
                end
            end)
        end
        TabPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteCanvasSize"):Connect(clampTabScroll)
        TabPage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"):Connect(clampTabScroll)

        local Tab = {Button = TabButton, Page = TabPage, NameSpanish = nameSpanish, NameEnglish = nameEnglish, IconAsset = iconAsset, IconLabel = TabIconLabel, DefaultIconAsset = defaultIconAsset, NameLabel = TabNameLabel, SpotifyMark = SpotifyMark}

        Tab._ContentParent = TabPage

        function Tab:CreateContentContainer(name)
            local container = mk("Frame", {
                Name = name or "ContentContainer",
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 8,
            }, TabPage)
            mk("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = container,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
            })
            return container
        end

        function Tab:SetContentContainer(container)
            self._ContentParent = container or TabPage
            return self._ContentParent
        end

        function Tab:GetContentContainer()
            return self._ContentParent or TabPage
        end

        function Tab:ResetContentContainer()
            self._ContentParent = TabPage
            return TabPage
        end

        local function Select()
            TabIconCarousel.ActiveTab = Tab
            for _, t in pairs(Window.Tabs) do
                t.Page.Visible = false
                t.Button.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
                t.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background
                t.Button.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0
            end
            TabButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            TabPage.Visible = true
            TabPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            task.defer(function()
                if TabPage and TabPage.Parent then
                    TabPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                end
            end)
            TabButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TabActive
            if Window._RefreshCompactNavigation then Window._RefreshCompactNavigation() end
        end

        TabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not TabIconCarousel.Enabled then
                Select()
            end
        end)

        TabButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
            if not isActive then
                TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = 0.30}):Play()
            end
        end)
        TabButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
            if not isActive then
                TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = (Window._SpotifyAmbient and Window._SpotifyAmbient.Active) and 1 or (Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0)}):Play()
            end
        end)
        TabButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
                if not isActive then
                    TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.10, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {BackgroundTransparency = 0.35}):Play()
                end
            end
        end)
        TabButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local isActive = (TabPage.Visible)
                if not isActive then
                    TweenService:Create(TabButton, TweenInfo.new(0.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {BackgroundTransparency = (Window._SpotifyAmbient and Window._SpotifyAmbient.Active) and 1 or (Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or 0)}):Play()
                end
            end
        end)

        table.insert(Window.Tabs, Tab)
        Tab.Select = Select
        if Window._RegisterCompactTab then Window._RegisterCompactTab(Tab) end
        Window._RegisterCarouselTab(Tab, TabButton, Select)
        if #Window.Tabs == 1 then Select() end
        if SavedConfig.TabIconLayout == "Carousel" then
            Window._RefreshTabIconLayout()
        end


        function Tab:CreateFloatingToggle(textSpanish, textEnglishOrDefault, defaultOrCallback, callback, creditInfo)
            local textEnglish = textSpanish
            local default, cb

            if type(textEnglishOrDefault) == "string" then
                textEnglish = textEnglishOrDefault
                default = defaultOrCallback
                cb = callback
            else
                default = textEnglishOrDefault
                cb = defaultOrCallback
            end

            local displayText = GetText(textSpanish, textEnglish)
            local state = default or false
            local isFloating = false
            local isLocked = false


            local tog = self:CreateToggle(textSpanish, textEnglish, state, function(newState)
                state = newState
                pcall(cb, state)
            end, nil, creditInfo)

            local Holder     = tog.Holder
            local HolderSwitch = tog.Switch
            local HolderClick  = tog.Click

            local credHasBadge = type(creditInfo) == "table" and (creditInfo.imageId or creditInfo.name) and true or false
            local credHasDesc  = type(creditInfo) == "table" and type(creditInfo.description) == "string" and #creditInfo.description > 0
            local hasCredit    = credHasBadge or credHasDesc
            local credZoneH    = (credHasBadge and credHasDesc) and 110 or 90
            local credRowY     = credZoneH + 4

            Holder.Size = hasCredit and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, credZoneH + 38) or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 92)
            HolderSwitch.Position = hasCredit and UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, math.floor(credZoneH / 2) - 14) or UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 18)

            local DetachBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 18),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Text = "↗",
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 13,
                ZIndex = 15
            })
            corner(DetachBtn, 6)
            RowKit.Control(DetachBtn, true)

            local PinBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, 18),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                Image = "rbxassetid://83537941312438",
                ImageColor3 = Theme.Text,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
                ZIndex = 15
            })
            corner(PinBtn, 6)
            stroke(PinBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
            RowKit.Control(PinBtn)

            local favId = nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish
            FloatingPillV5.Studio.Register(favId, textSpanish, textEnglish, nameSpanish, "Toggle")
            local isFavorite = SavedFavoriteIds[favId] or false
            local FavBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -164, 0, 17),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431",
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 15
            })

            local isInCombo = false
            local ComboBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -194, 0, 20),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                Image = "rbxassetid://114334068728895",
                ImageColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 15
            })
            corner(ComboBtn, 6)
            stroke(ComboBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
            ComboBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeImageRole", "TextDim")
            RowKit.Control(ComboBtn)

            local KeybindBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 20),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -164, 1, -27),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
                Text = GetText("Tecla: Sin tecla", "Key: No key"),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 10,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Active = true,
                Selectable = false,
                ZIndex = 15,
            })
            KeybindBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            KeybindBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
            corner(KeybindBtn, 6)
            stroke(KeybindBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.45)
            RowKit.Control(KeybindBtn)
            KeybindBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35

            if hasCredit then
                ComboBtn.Position   = UDim2.new(0, 22,   0, credRowY + 2)
                FavBtn.Position     = UDim2.new(0, 50,   0, credRowY - 3)
                DetachBtn.Position  = UDim2.new(0, 88,   0, credRowY)
                PinBtn.Position     = UDim2.new(0, 120,  0, credRowY)
                KeybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, credRowY + 3)
                for _, child in ipairs(Holder:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Size.X.Offset == 3 and child.Size.Y.Offset == 36 then
                        child.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, math.floor(credZoneH / 2) - 18)
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            local _linkedSliderRef    = nil
            local _linkedSliderFavRow = nil
            local _dialList = nil -- sliders del tambor (LinkDial)
            local favRow = nil
            local toggleFloating
            local toggleLock
            local favoriteControlRefreshers = {}

            local function syncFavoriteRow()
                favoriteControlRefreshers = {}
                if favRow then
                    pcall(function() favRow.Holder:Destroy() end)
                    favRow = nil
                end
                if _linkedSliderFavRow then
                    pcall(function() _linkedSliderFavRow.Holder:Destroy() end)
                    _linkedSliderFavRow = nil
                end

                if isFavorite and AutoTabFavoritosRef then
                    favRow = AutoTabFavoritosRef:CreateToggle(textSpanish, textEnglish, state, function(newState)
                        state = newState
                        tog.SetValue(newState)
                        pcall(cb, newState)
                    end, true)
                    Window._AddFavoriteFloatControls(
                        favRow.Holder, toggleFloating, toggleLock,
                        function() return isFloating end,
                        function() return isLocked end,
                        function(refresh) table.insert(favoriteControlRefreshers, refresh) end
                    )

                    if _linkedSliderRef then
                        local liveValue = _linkedSliderRef._value or 50
                        if type(_linkedSliderRef.Get) == "function" then
                            local okGet, gotValue = pcall(_linkedSliderRef.Get)
                            if okGet and type(gotValue) == "number" then liveValue = gotValue end
                        end
                        _linkedSliderFavRow = AutoTabFavoritosRef:CreateSlider(
                            _linkedSliderRef._labelES or "Slider",
                            _linkedSliderRef._min     or 0,
                            _linkedSliderRef._max     or 100,
                            liveValue,
                            function(newVal)
                                _linkedSliderRef._value = newVal
                                if _linkedSliderRef._callback then
                                    pcall(_linkedSliderRef._callback, newVal)
                                end
                            end,
                            true
                        )
                    end
                end
            end

            FavBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                isFavorite = not isFavorite
                FavBtn.Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431"
                SavedFavoriteIds[favId] = isFavorite or nil
                syncFavoriteRow()
                SyncFavoritesToConfig()
            end)

            local comboMember = {
                Initial = displayText:sub(1, 1):upper(),
                DisplayName = displayText,
                GetState = function() return state end,
                SetState = function(newState)
                    state = newState
                    tog.SetValue(newState)
                    pcall(cb, newState)
                end,
            }

            ComboBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                isInCombo = not isInCombo
                ComboBtn.ImageColor3 = isInCombo and Theme.Accent or Theme.TextDim
                ComboBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeImageRole", isInCombo and "Accent" or "TextDim")
                if isInCombo then
                    Window.AddComboMember(comboMember)
                else
                    Window.RemoveComboMember(comboMember)
                end
            end)

            Window.RegisterKeybind(favId, KeybindBtn, function()
                state = not state
                tog.SetValue(state)
                if favRow and favRow.SetValue then
                    favRow.SetValue(state)
                end
                pcall(cb, state)
            end)
            KeybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                Window.BeginKeybindCapture(Window.Keybinds[favId])
            end)

            tog.LinkSlider = function(self, sliderObj)
                _linkedSliderRef = sliderObj
                if isFavorite then
                    syncFavoriteRow()
                end
            end

            HolderClick.Size = hasCredit and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, credZoneH) or UDim2.new(1, -206, 1, 0)

            -- Tarjeta de dos zonas: nombre a la izquierda y controles a la derecha.
            if not hasCredit then
                Holder.ClipsDescendants = true
                Holder:SetAttribute("OptionCardV5", true)
                Holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
                local label, status
                for _, child in ipairs(Holder:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("TextLabel") and child:GetAttribute("TextSpanish") == textSpanish then
                        label = child
                    elseif child:IsA("TextLabel") and child.Text:sub(1, 3) == "●" then
                        status = child
                    elseif child:IsA("Frame") and child.Size.X.Offset == 3 and child.Size.Y.Offset == 36 then
                        child.Visible = false
                    end
                end
                -- El borde del panel y la línea comparten el mismo eje geométrico.
                local panel = mk("Frame", {
                    Name = "OptionControlsPanel", Parent = Holder, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.34,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 9,
                })
                panel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
                local separator = mk("Frame", {
                    Name = "OptionDivider", Parent = Holder, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.40, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 96),
                    Rotation = 16, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10,
                })
                corner(separator, 2)
                local dividerGradient = mk("UIGradient", {Parent = separator, Rotation = 90})
                FavBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary
                FavBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                FavBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
                corner(FavBtn, 9)
                local favoriteBorder = stroke(FavBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
                favoriteBorder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Stroke")
                -- Borde suave de la tarjeta y cápsula inferior de tecla, como en la referencia.
                local rim = mk("Frame", {
                    Name = "OptionRim", Parent = Holder, Position = UDim2.new(0.40, 0, 0, 1),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0.60, -1, 1, -2), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = 12,
                })
                corner(rim, 14)
                local rimStroke = stroke(rim, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1.5, 0.12)
                local rimGradient = mk("UIGradient", {Parent = rimStroke, Rotation = 0,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.025, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.06, 0),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})})
                KeybindBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                KeybindBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", nil)
                local keyPlate = mk("Frame", {Parent = KeybindBtn, Name = "KeyPlate",
                    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 14, Active = false})
                keyPlate:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
                corner(keyPlate, 999)
                mk("UIGradient", {Parent = keyPlate, Rotation = 25,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.025, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.06, 0),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})})
                local keySlash = mk("Frame", {Parent = KeybindBtn, Name = "KeySlash",
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 20), Rotation = 27, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ToggleOn,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.05, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = 16})
                keySlash:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "ToggleOn")
                corner(keySlash, 2)
                local keyGlow = mk("Frame", {Parent = KeybindBtn, Name = "KeySlashGlow",
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 21), Rotation = 27, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ToggleOn,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.75, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = 15})
                keyGlow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "ToggleOn")
                corner(keyGlow, 3)
                local keyCorner = KeybindBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                if keyCorner then keyCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) end
                local keyBorder = KeybindBtn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if keyBorder then
                    keyBorder.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                    keyBorder.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    keyBorder.Transparency = 0.12
                    keyBorder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", nil)
                    keyBorder.Thickness = 1.4
                end
                local keyGradient = keyBorder and mk("UIGradient", {Parent = keyBorder,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.025, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.07, 0),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})})
                local function updateRim()
                    local accent = Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
                    local second = Theme.ToggleOn or accent
                    dividerGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, accent),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, second),
                    })
                    rimGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, accent),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.70, accent),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, accent),
                    })
                    if keyGradient then
                        keyGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, second),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, second),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, accent),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, accent),
                        })
                    end
                end
                Holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(updateRim)
                updateRim()
                if status then status.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
                local function layoutOptionCard()
                    if not Holder.Parent then return end
                    local logicalWidth = Holder.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(MainScale.Scale, 0.01)
                    if logicalWidth <= 0 then return end
                    local narrow = logicalWidth < 330
                    Holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, narrow and 118 or 92)
                    if narrow then
                        panel.Rotation = 0
                        panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 67)
                        panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -38.5)
                    else
                        local angle = math.rad(16)
                        local panelWidth = logicalWidth * 2
                        local panelHeight = math.max(276, 2 * (92 + logicalWidth * math.sin(angle)))
                        -- Centro del borde izquierdo después de rotar, igual al centro de la línea.
                        local edgeX, edgeY = logicalWidth * 0.40, 46
                        panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panelWidth, panelHeight)
                        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(edgeX + panelWidth * math.cos(angle) / 2,
                            edgeY + panelWidth * math.sin(angle) / 2)
                        panel.Rotation = 16
                    end
                    separator.Visible = not narrow
                    rim.Position = narrow and UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1) or UDim2.new(0.40, 0, 0, 1)
                    rim.Size = narrow and UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2) or UDim2.new(0.60, -1, 1, -2)
                    if label then
                        label.Size = narrow and UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22) or UDim2.new(0.38, -26, 0, 22)
                        label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, narrow and 4 or 13)
                    end
                    if status then
                        status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, narrow and 25 or 38)
                    end
                    local y = narrow and 48 or 18
                    HolderSwitch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, y)
                    ComboBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -194, 0, y + 2)
                    FavBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -164, 0, y - 1)
                    DetachBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, y)
                    PinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, y)
                    KeybindBtn.Position = narrow and UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -27) or UDim2.new(0.38, 12, 1, -27)
                    KeybindBtn.Size = narrow and UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20) or UDim2.new(0.62, -26, 0, 20)
                    HolderClick.Size = narrow and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44) or UDim2.new(0.38, -6, 1, 0)
                end
                Holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layoutOptionCard)
                layoutOptionCard()
            end
            -- El interruptor de la derecha también debe responder al toque directo.
            local switchHit = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = HolderSwitch, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 16,
            })
            switchHit.Activated:Connect(function()
                state = not state
                tog.SetValue(state)
                if favRow and favRow.SetValue then favRow.SetValue(state) end
                pcall(cb, state)
            end)
            HolderClick.ZIndex = 14
            
            
            local FloatingWindow = nil
            local FloatingGlow = nil
            local animationConnection = nil
            
            local function createFloatingWindow()

                local floatStyle    = SavedConfig.FloatingToggleStyle or "Pill"
                local isCircleStyle = (floatStyle == "Circle")
                local hasLinkedSlider = (_linkedSliderRef ~= nil) and not isCircleStyle
                local floatW = isCircleStyle and 64 or 200
                local floatH = isCircleStyle and 64 or (hasLinkedSlider and 76 or 36)
                local usePillV5 = not isCircleStyle
                if usePillV5 and not hasLinkedSlider then
                    floatW = FloatingPillV5.FitWidth(displayText, 21)
                    floatH = 30
                end
                local hasDial = usePillV5 and not hasLinkedSlider and type(_dialList) == "table" and #_dialList > 0

                FloatingGlow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(216, 48),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -108, 0.5, -24),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 3
                })
                corner(FloatingGlow, 999)

                FloatingWindow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(floatW, floatH),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -floatW/2, 0.5, -floatH/2),
                    BackgroundColor3 = isCircleStyle and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26) or FloatingPillV5.OffColor(),
                    BackgroundTransparency = isCircleStyle and 0.55 or 0.45,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex = 4
                })
                FloatPos.Apply(favId, FloatingWindow)
                if FloatPos.IsLocked(favId) then
                    isLocked = true
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                end
                if not usePillV5 then
                    FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
                else
                    FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("YYPillV5", true)
                end
                FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("SupportsFloatStyle", true)
                FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("HasLinkedSlider", hasLinkedSlider)
                if hasDial then FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("YYDialExtraPad", 12) end
                corner(FloatingWindow, 999)

                local floatStroke
                if usePillV5 then
                    floatStroke = stroke(FloatingWindow, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 2, 0)
                else
                    floatStroke = stroke(FloatingWindow, Theme.Accent, 3, 0.20)
                    buildAnimatedBorder(FloatingWindow, Theme.Border, UDim.new(1, 0), true)
                end

                local FloatLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = FloatingWindow,
                    Size = isCircleStyle and UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24)
                        or hasLinkedSlider and UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34)
                        or UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0),
                    Position = isCircleStyle and UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12) or UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = displayText,
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                    TextSize = isCircleStyle and 11 or (hasLinkedSlider and 17 or 21),
                    TextWrapped = isCircleStyle,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                    TextTruncate = isCircleStyle and Enum.TextTruncate.None or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    ZIndex = 5,
                })
